Title: Blackboard & Shared State
Implementation Details: Multi-space state in testforge/blackboard.py: TargetSpace, SuiteSpace, MutantSpace, CriticSpace, MetricsSpace. SQLite persistence with WAL & atomic checkpoints.

Title: At Least Two Real MCP Integrations
Implementation Details: FastMCP servers in testforge/mcp_server.py: 1) Filesystem MCP Server (read_text_file, list_directory, get_file_info) and 2) GitHub MCP Server (get_file_contents, get_repository_info).

Title: Structured Pydantic Outputs
Implementation Details: Pydantic v2 models for CriticDirectivePayload, AgentCard, TargetMetadata, BlastRadiusReport with strict validation.

Title: Agentic Design Patterns & Comparison
Implementation Details: Reflection loop (Generator <-> Critic), Blackboard pattern, Tool-augmented LLM. Empirical comparison in benchmark_results.md.

Title: Callbacks Monitoring & Logging
Implementation Details: Central callback registry in testforge/callbacks.py, WebSocket event hub, TraceLogger JSONL wiretap.

Title: Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol
Implementation Details: Official A2A v0.3.0 AgentCard at /.well-known/agent-card.json, typed A2AMessage envelopes, in-browser protocol validator with anti-SSRF defense.

Title: CrewAI & Google ADK
Implementation Details: Official crewai.Agent/Crew/Task with BaseLLM bridge in testforge/crew_critic.py; Google ADK generator in testforge/adk_generator.py with Pass@1 validation.

Title: Security Guardrails & Sanitizer
Implementation Details: Subprocess sandbox isolation (testforge/sandbox.py), AST import sanitizer (testforge/security.py), Pass@1 clean code protection, FastMCP traversal block, A2A anti-SSRF.

Title: Observability & Provenance
Implementation Details: Correlation IDs, structured JSONL logging, live wiretap /api/wiretap, monotonic Blackboard revisions (Rev 76), checkpoint unified diffs.

Title: Multi-Run Benchmarking
Implementation Details: BenchmarkRunner with configurable repetitions, latency/score/coverage/tokens/cost metrics, single-run vs multi-run explicit disclosure.

Title: Cloud Deployment Readiness
Implementation Details: Production Dockerfile (python:3.13-slim, non-root user, HEALTHCHECK /healthz), docker-compose.yml, .dockerignore, /healthz and /readyz probes. Note: container build/config verified locally; no live external cloud deployment claimed.
